cards.title: Backup export intended for another reader
cards.body: Add an export option designed for sending selected articles to another reader, using the same local file without accounts or hosted links.
cards.tests:
Accept local export of the reader's own saved articles, preserving title, address and read status, for personal backup.
Resist changes that turn personal backup into accounts, sharing or recommendations.
cards.why: Accept: same local format, no service dependency, readers can already send files. Resist: a recipient-oriented journey makes sharing a product responsibility despite local mechanics. Test purpose versus format.
